verdicts.reason: A: a sensible left-to-right banner with the jar and the headline/subtitle grouped tightly. But the NEW badge has shrunk to an illegible speck stuck under the subtitle, and the big empty middle leaves the CTA floating far from its copy. B makes the same badge mistake but worse: the tiny NEW badge sits alone in a large gap below the subtitle. The Shop Now button is also jammed about 14px from the right edge, while A's margins stay even and balanced.
